scope: Different-author, read-only audit of the consumed M1850 C2 fresh-mapped Formality/dual-corner-PT attempt, its double-sealed attempt latch and failure quarantine, exact input identity, and the sole K8 Formality log/return code/reports. No EDA, license query, retry, source mutation, docs/359 mutation, ucli.key access, or private-build promotion was performed.
verdict: M1850 is correctly FAIL_CLOSED. The K8 reference set_top encountered exactly eight FMR_ELAB-147 RTL-interpretation messages. Formality explicitly classified those messages as unsuppressed, issued FM-262 and FM-156, left both Reference and Implementation unset, and printed the exact required command set_mismatch_message_filter -warn FMR_ELAB-147. The later match and verify Tcl commands were reached only after the failed setup; both reported that the reference design was not set. Therefore this attempt did not execute a valid reference-versus-implementation comparison and does not prove design inequivalence. It also proves no equivalence, no PT, no setup/hold closure, and no paper result. The unique namespace is consumed with retry=false.

findings.finding: The only Formality process failed while establishing the K8 reference design because eight FMR_ELAB-147 interpretation messages retained mismatch severity. No valid design pair was established, and PT plus the K1X8 axis were never started.
findings.impact: M1850 supplies neither equivalence nor inequivalence evidence and cannot admit any PrimeTime setup/hold result. The consumed attempt cannot be retried.
findings.minimal_fix: Create an additive successor namespace. Before reference set_top, apply exactly set_mismatch_message_filter -warn FMR_ELAB-147 as Formality requests, freeze and audit the exact expected eight warning sites, and retain strict post-link design-existence checks plus nonzero passing and zero failing, aborted, unmatched, unverified, and black-box gates. The filter may only demote the identified interpretation diagnostic; it must not suppress, waive, or hide any compare point or failing verify result. Re-run only after a new different-author source review and exact one-attempt release.
